adjudication.rationale: In `spec/controllers/admin/groups_controller_spec.rb` under `context ".remove_member"`, the test `"cannot remove members from automatic groups"` calls `xhr :put, :remove_member, group_id: 1, user_id: 42`, but the route added in `config/routes.rb` wires member removal to `DELETE /admin/groups/:group_id/members => groups#remove_member`. Because this is a controller spec, `xhr :put` will still invoke the action, so it won’t catch verb/routing mismatches. Also, the test hardcodes `group_id: 1` and does not fabricate an automatic group or assert membership is unchanged, so it weakly exercises the intended guard (`return can_not_modify_automatic if group.automatic`) and relies on implicit state (that id 1 is an automatic group). This is a specific, diff-grounded test quality issue rather than a production defect.
